    • getQuizzesPaged

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Quiz> getQuizzesPaged(int page, int size, Boolean active)
      Retrieve quizzes in a paginated and alphabetically ordered manner.

      This method fetches quizzes from the database ordered by their title in ascending order and returns a Page containing the requested page of quizzes. Pagination parameters allow clients to specify which page and how many items per page should be returned.

      If the requested page exceeds the total number of pages, an empty page will be returned.

      Specified by:
      getQuizzesPaged in interface IQuizService
      Parameters:
      page - the zero-based page index (0 = first page)
      size - the number of quizzes to return per page
      Returns:
      a Page of Quiz objects, sorted by title in ascending order

    • getQuestionsByQuizPaged

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Question> getQuestionsByQuizPaged(Long qid, int page, int size)
      Retrieves paginated questions for a specific quiz.

      This method first verifies that the quiz exists. Then, it retrieves the questions associated with that quiz using pagination and sorting (by question ID ascending).

      Specified by:
      getQuestionsByQuizPaged in interface IQuizService
      Parameters:
      qid - the ID of the quiz
      page - the zero-based page index (0 = first page)
      size - the number of questions per page
      Returns:
      a Page of Question objects belonging to the quiz
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the quiz does not exist

    • searchQuizzesPaged

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Quiz> searchQuizzesPaged(String term, int page, int size, Boolean active)
      Searches quizzes by a given term and returns a paginated result.

      The search is performed using the repository method to fetch quizzes matching the term. Results are then sorted alphabetically by title and paginated manually according to the requested page and size.

      Specified by:
      searchQuizzesPaged in interface IQuizService
      Parameters:
      term - the search term to filter quizzes by title or other relevant fields
      page - the page number to retrieve (0-based)
      size - the number of quizzes per page
      Returns:
      a Page of Quiz containing the paginated search results

    • searchQuestionsByQuizPaged

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Question> searchQuestionsByQuizPaged(Long qid, String term, int page, int size)
      Searches questions within a specific quiz by a given search term and returns a paginated result.

      The search includes the question's content, all options (option1-4), and the answer. It uses the repository method to perform the query directly in the database, which is efficient for large quizzes.

      Specified by:
      searchQuestionsByQuizPaged in interface IQuizService
      Parameters:
      qid - the ID of the quiz whose questions are being searched
      term - the search term to filter questions; matches against content, options, or answer
      page - the page number to retrieve (0-based)
      size - the number of questions per page
      Returns:
      a Page of Question containing the search results for the requested page

    • searchQuizByCategoryPaged

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Quiz> searchQuizByCategoryPaged(Long categoryId, String term, int page, int size, Boolean active)
      Searches quizzes within a specific category by a given search term and returns a paginated result.

      The search includes matching the term against the quiz's title, description, max marks, or number of questions. The results are sorted alphabetically by title and manually paginated according to the requested page and size.

      Specified by:
      searchQuizByCategoryPaged in interface IQuizService
      Parameters:
      categoryId - the ID of the category to filter quizzes
      term - the search term to filter quizzes within the category
      page - the page number to retrieve (0-based)
      size - the number of quizzes per page
      Returns:
      a Page of Quiz containing the quizzes that match the search term within the specified category
